ImageDescription.value:
Bjarni Fel is a sports bar located in the heart of Reykjavik, right next to the popular Hressingarskalinn. Named after Iceland´s most famous sports commenter Bjarni Felixson the bar has all major sports event shown live on multiple flat screens inside

The bar itself is decorated in a classic style with old vintage photos that show Reykjavik and major sport events held in the capital through the years. If you look closely you might also see old photos of the famous Bjarni Fel from back when he was a professional athlete.

The bar offers a good casual menu, focusing on tasty non-pretentious food that fits perfectly with a cold beer over a live broadcast. If you would like to see any event that is not on the schedule the staff at Bjarni Fel will gladly find it on some of the sport channels for you to be able to watch it live so donæt be afraid to ask for your favorite event to be shown live.
